title: Peptide-spectrum match
summary: A proposed spectrum-to-peptide association, distinct from a peptide count or a guaranteed identification.
zh_summary: 提出的谱图与肽段对应关系，不等于肽段计数或确定无误的鉴定。

title: Protein inference
summary: Evaluate parent-protein evidence while retaining shared-peptide ambiguity and protein-group membership.
zh_summary: 评估母体蛋白质证据，同时保留共享肽段歧义和蛋白质分组成员。

title: Proteotypic peptide
summary: A reliably observable peptide in a defined workflow; check sequence specificity separately.
zh_summary: 在明确流程中能可靠观察的肽段；序列特异性仍须单独检验。

title: Post-translational modification
summary: A protein change after translation, distinguished from preparation chemistry, mass-shift hypotheses, and site assignments.
zh_summary: 翻译后发生的蛋白质变化，应与制备化学、质量偏移假设和位点指认区分。

title: Site localization
summary: Determine a modification position using evidence that distinguishes competing placements.
zh_summary: 利用能够区分竞争位置的证据，确定修饰位点。

title: Sequence coverage
summary: The fraction of reference residue positions covered by accepted peptide mappings, counting overlaps once.
zh_summary: 通过筛选的肽段映射所覆盖的参考残基位置比例，重叠位置仅计一次。
